location.site_description: Meta campus in Middleton Township, Wood County; power-generation facility is adjacent near Mercer Road and Middleton Pike / State Route 582.

evidence_grade: A- for status/location/owner and official/local-process milestones (Meta 2025-04-09 announcement, Middleton Township project page/letter, OPSB Apollo approval, township 2026-07-07 rezoning); B for capacity_mw because 180 MW rests only on a third-party tracker (ryangrissinger.com OH-DC-0049) report of Meta-stated peak IT demand and no official Meta/OPSB IT-load figure was found.

actions.summary: Meta announced the Bowling Green Data Center in Middleton Township as a 715,000-square-foot campus, Meta's 24th U.S. and 28th global data center, with more than $800 million investment and about 100 operational jobs once completed.
Township published Meta's response letter on water, energy, air quality, construction, jobs, and community impacts for the Bowling Green Data Center.

OPSB approved Will-Power OH, LLC's Apollo Power Generation Facility, a 350 MW behind-the-meter natural-gas generation facility with about 120 MW battery storage, to serve the adjacent Liames data center campus.

Trustees approved Application 2026041 rezoning 13 Liames parcels from A-1/R-4 to M-1 Light Industrial after a public hearing; county planning had recommended approval and the township zoning commission had recommended denial.

capacity_mw_notes: Peak IT demand reported by a public tracker as Meta-stated; primary Meta announcement confirms 715,000 sq ft but does not publish IT MW. Separate adjacent Apollo facility is 350 MW gas plus about 120 MW BESS approved by OPSB.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.summary: Meta's letter PDF served by Middleton Township is posted as a January 7, 2026 letter in the township article, but the PDF text itself displays January 7, 2025 even though it references Meta's April 9, 2025 announcement. Treated as a 2026 township-posted document with a date typo.

Public tracker reports 180 MW peak IT demand as Meta-stated; official Meta and OPSB pages reviewed in this refresh do not publish the data center IT-load figure. OPSB does confirm a separate 350 MW behind-the-meter plant and about 120 MW BESS for Liames.
